description: The main window, by the label MAIN_WINDOW in src/lib.rs; rename both together. Grants the fifteen bridge commands of src/commands.rs, one permission each (docs/decisions/0012-desktop-bridge.md, docs/decisions/0019-app-stream-to-the-window.md, open_external, open_file and reveal in docs/decisions/0026-open-and-reveal.md, open_settings in docs/decisions/0028-settings-window.md, and setup in docs/decisions/0048-signin-on-the-wire.md, whose allow-list per window is in src/setup/admit.rs), and the two window commands of Tauri's drag script for the room's title bar, DRAG_PERMISSIONS in src/window_frame.rs (docs/decisions/0015-window-frame.md). Nothing else: every permission widens what script in the page can reach.
